description: The bar chart illustrates module-level computational cost (in Giga-FLOPs) for different components of an audio back-end Conformer across three stages. The horizontal axis contains the categorical stages labeled “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500),” “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250),” and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125),” arranged left to right, with the axis label “Audio back-end Conformer Stage.” The vertical axis is labeled “Module Giga-FLOPs” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 0.3, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3). Each stage shows a grouped set of four bars corresponding to the legend: attention (blue), grouped attention (g=3) (red), patch attention (k=3) (yellow), and feed-forward (green). In Stage 1, the blue attention bar is approximately 0.28, the red grouped attention bar about 0.16, the yellow patch attention bar about 0.12, and the green feed-forward bar about 0.13. In Stage 2, the blue attention bar is about 0.16, the red grouped attention bar about 0.12, the yellow patch attention bar about 0.10–0.11, and the green feed-forward bar about 0.13. In Stage 3, the blue attention bar is about 0.12, the red grouped attention bar about 0.10–0.11, the yellow patch attention bar about 0.10, and the green feed-forward bar about 0.13. The bars are grouped by stage with consistent color coding across groups, there is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the legend and standard coloring.
